resources.string: Tap A beside the message field to underline dates and bold names in your draft. Hold A to edit the dictionary. The message is only sent when you tap Send.
One name or spelling per line. Add inflected forms on separate lines. Only listed names are matched; an empty list disables name formatting.
Plain text messages are left-aligned without bubbles. Avatar, name, time and send status appear at the top. Media, replies and forwards currently keep their native layout.
No chats here yet. Tap + on the left to manage Telegram folders.
